title: Step 57 high-fidelity UI and prototype acceptance
description: Complete Step 57 high-fidelity storefront and admin prototype acceptance against the canonical Step 54 design system and Step 55/56 UX contracts, including deterministic browser QA, accessibility, responsive behavior, safe NO_ACTION handling, and final approval evidence. Step 58 remains out of scope.

dependencies.name: RTL Design System and Accessibility Foundation

acceptance_criteria.description: All 134 Step 57 surfaces remain traceable: 37 storefront and 97 admin.
The exhaustive Chromium audit covers canonical widths 320, 360, 600, 840, 1200 and 1440, browser errors, internal navigation, accessibility checks, keyboard/focus behavior and interaction exercises.
All 1142 inherited admin views and 4472 inherited admin states are represented in deterministic QA coverage without enabling real mutations.
All inherited NO_ACTION operations remain visibly unavailable or disabled and cannot be represented as successful executable actions.
Persian RTL, integer Toman, no Wallet, no brown palette, Step 54 tokens, safe critical-action semantics and WCAG 2.2 AA-oriented contracts are preserved.

Canonical CI, Phase A Verification, Step 57 Prototype Verification and Merge Policy run on the exact final artifact; merge remains blocked until artifact-bound Review, Security, Lock and Project Owner Human Approval evidence are valid.
Step 58 implementation does not start within this task.
